Frequently asked questions

How many Data Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 20 open Data Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

How much do Data Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $103,000–$109,000 a year, based on 15 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Data Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include SynergisticIT (11 listings), Vantor (2 listings), DraftKings (1 listing), Lockheed Martin (1 listing), and PwC (1 listing).

Do I need experience?

These listings match explicit entry-level, junior, graduate or early-career titles. A title alone does not confirm an experience requirement; review the original posting.
